appliedUpdates.description: Updated rust-crates.md to document that xcap 0.8.x monitor property accessors (name, width, height, x, y, scale_factor) return Result types, not direct values. Previous documentation showed direct value access which was incorrect.

Updated architecture.md to reflect that platform-specific code uses inline #[cfg(target_os)] gates within each module rather than a separate src/platform/ directory. Removed non-existent platform/ directory from module layout. This matches the actual codebase convention used by all existing primitives.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update the error handling convention: AGENTS.md says 'Use anyhow::Result for error propagation in main/commands' but all existing primitives (mouse, keyboard, clipboard, display, screen) use the exit_with_error() pattern with process::exit() in handler functions that return (). The documented convention should be updated to match the actual pattern: 'Use XctrlError with exit_with_error() in command handler functions. The anyhow::Result pattern is not used.'
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: display-primitive reviewer found that src/display.rs, src/mouse.rs, src/keyboard.rs, src/clipboard.rs, src/screen.rs all use exit_with_error() pattern. None use anyhow::Result in handler functions.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify exit code convention: architecture.md specifies 'Exit codes: 0 = success, 1 = error, 2 = missing dependency' but the implementation uses exit code 1 for all errors including missing dependencies (e.g., FFmpeg not found). Either update the convention to use exit code 1 for everything, or update the code to use exit code 2 for missing dependencies.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: screen-recording reviewer found src/screen.rs uses exit code 1 for FFmpeg-not-found errors. All other error paths also use exit code 1.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add nuance to rust-worker skill's 'Write Tests First' (TDD red-phase) step: for system integration features (process management, FFmpeg invocation, state file persistence), writing tests alongside implementation is more practical than strict test-first. Note this exception in the skill.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: screen-recording worker feedback: 'strict TDD red-phase is impractical for screen recording since many tests require the implementation to exist (process spawning, state files).'

rejectedObservations.observation: xcap system dependencies (wayland-devel, pipewire-devel, clang-devel, mesa-libEGL-devel, mesa-libgbm-devel, libdrm-devel) not documented in init.sh
rejectedObservations.reason: Already documented: init.sh already includes all these packages (added in commit 5827785). environment.md also documents them. Reviewer may have checked an outdated version.
